_comment: Runtime-only config consumed by `node -r tsconfig-paths/register` in the service images. tsc does NOT rewrite TS path aliases (@platform/*) in the emitted JS, so at runtime they must be resolved here. Because services import the shared packages from source, tsc nests the build as dist/services/<svc>/src and dist/packages/<pkg>/src; baseUrl=dist maps the aliases onto those compiled packages.
